# The divergence's trigger is the RUNNING process's PATH, not the play's
# `environment:` keyword: ansible.posix.synchronize resolves the rsync binary
# with get_bin_path(rsync, required=True) inside the module, so its failure
# quotes whatever directories it searched. Pinned to a directory that does not
# exist so this box's rsync is never found - exactly the state the round's host
# was in.
PATH=/nonexistent/1643-no-rsync-bin
